verdict.rationale: React documents `hydrateRoot` for hydrating server-generated HTML (react-docs-9). It also documents streaming HTML from the server, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads (react-docs-6). Together these cover hydration and progressive server rendering. However, the pack never explicitly describes progressive or selective hydration, i.e. making parts of the page interactive incrementally. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of progressive/selective (Suspense-based) hydration, evidence that interactivity arrives faster, independent or hands-on corroboration.
